fact: The article, published in November 2019, states that a prototype electronic clinical record for obstetrics, adapted from ObsCare, was in its test phase at the 180-bed Irene Neto maternity hospital in Lubango, with the clinical processes of deliveries from the fourth quarter of 2016 being keyed in retrospectively by the admission, archive and medical statistics section.
title: Technology and Hospital Information System: A Case of Implementation of Electronic Clinical Records in Hospital Maternity Irene Neto in Lubango, Angola
publisher: Journal of Business and Economics (Academic Star Publishing Company)
